title: feat(spec)!: key an object extension's fieldPatches by the field map's own key grammar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9T3v3ZgJMgqevubSmheyLPf)_
Fixes #29366

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` ("A patch must name something real") gains the key grammar. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` keys its `fieldPatches` example by `industry`, so every taught line stays true and no skill line changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对象扩展的 `fieldPatches` 的键改用与对象 `fields` 完全相同的键 schema(小写 snake_case),`Industry`、`Annual Revenue` 这类不可能是字段名的键在解析时就被拒,报一个带示例的 `invalid_key`。
- 为什么改:以前任何字符串都能过 schema,这种补丁在 `defineStack`、保存门、启动时都被接受,启动只在日志里点名、什么也不改;作者以为改了标签,界面却没变。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(BREAKING,spec minor,ADR-0087 语义迁移条目已登记)。仓内 examples/skills/docs/模板无一处写过这种键;已存储的带坏键的扩展行同步时会整行注册失败。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`(`FieldNameKeySchema` 与 `fieldPatches` 的 `invalid_key` 文案)、`packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.test.ts` 末尾新一节、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-customization.test.ts`,预期 1 个文件全绿(93 条)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: the key schema `ObjectSchema.fields` used inline (the snake_case regex and its message) is hoisted, unchanged, to one module constant `FieldNameKeySchema` (not exported), declared above `ObjectSchemaBase`. `ObjectSchema.fields` and `ObjectExtensionSchema.fieldPatches` both read it, so the grammar is written once and the two cannot drift. `fieldPatches`' record error map answers `invalid_key` with a prescription: the key is a field name the extended object declares, lowercase snake_case such as `industry` or `annual_revenue`, never a label. The issue sits at `fieldPatches.KEY`, as the option-key refusal sits at `fieldPatches.FIELD.options.KEY`. The `fieldPatches` describe and its doc comment name the grammar.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused.ts`: the ADR-0087 semantic entry (refused, with a prescription; no conversion, because a respelling can land on another field or on none).
- `.changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md`: spec `minor`, BREAKING, `adr-0087: registered object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused`, with the FROM → TO line.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`: one sentence in "A patch must name something real".
- `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`: regenerated (the describe moved).
- No public export is added or removed (`check:api-surface` unchanged). No forced test edit. `ui/packages` has no zod twin of `fieldPatches` (`git grep` hits only the Studio controls that write keys read from the target's own field names).

## Why — the measurement that chose the declaration

The target judge (`@objectstack/metadata-core` `fieldPatchTargetMisses`) does NOT reach every door, so a non-grammar key was accepted end to end before:

- `defineStack` / `defineObjectExtension`: pure schema, no target judge; the key parsed.
- `/api/v1/meta` `object_extension` save door: `OBJECT_EXTENSION_ITEM_SCHEMA` is `ObjectExtensionSchema` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts`); the save door's refusal (`objectExtensionItemRefusal`) runs the `__c` suffix judge, not the target judge, so the row was stored.
- Boot / registry fold (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, the `fieldPatchTargetMisses` call in the extension fold): never refuses; the patch is not applied and named once in the log.
- `os validate`: refuses only when the target is in the composed stack (`packages/cli/src/utils/field-patch-targets.ts`); a target outside it is left to the install door.
- Marketplace install door: refuses (the only door that always did).

So this is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, BREAKING, with the semantic migration entry the delta prescribes for that branch.

Authored forms: every `fieldPatches` key in `examples/**`, `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` (references excluded), `packages/**/templates`, dogfood and test fixtures is snake_case (`industry` ×20+, `name`, `sector`, `notes`, `region`, `state`, `anything`, `no_such_field`, plus the deliberate `region__c` and `__proto__` refusal fixtures), so nothing authored in this repository newly refuses.

One consequence to read: a stored `object_extension` row that carries such a key no longer parses, so the sync that registers stored extensions (`registrableObjectExtension` → `INVALID_METADATA`) names the row and registers none of it, its `fields` included. This is the uniform effect of any `ObjectExtensionSchema` narrowing (PR #29331 had the same), stated in the changeset and the migration entry.

**No stored-shape detector, measured (round 2).** The contract review asked for a `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector so `os migrate meta --stored` lists such a row before the upgrade refuses it. None can be reached: `applyConversionsToStoredItem` wraps a row in the stack collection its type maps to, and `object_extension` maps to none (it is in neither `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL` nor the stored-only map in `conversions/stored.ts`), so the stored pass returns the row untouched. Probe on this branch: `applyConversionsToStoredItem('object_extension', { extend, fieldPatches: { Industry: … }, fields: { shift_at: { type: 'time', defaultValue: '12:00Z' } } }, { onTodo, onNotice })` returns the same reference with 0 TODOs and 0 notices, while the control `applyConversionsToStoredItem('object', …)` rewrites the time default (1 notice). A detector walking `objectExtensions` would therefore be dead code, so none is added; the semantic entry and the changeset say the stored pass does not list such a row, and name the check an operator runs instead.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.test.ts` gains `fieldPatches keys — the field map's own key grammar` (8 cases): `Industry`, `Annual Revenue`, `annual-revenue`, `2nd_phone` each refused with exactly one `invalid_key` at `fieldPatches.KEY` (message names the grammar and an example, no tracker id); CONTROL a snake_case key parses and a `__c` key stays the `__c` rule's single `custom` issue; CONTROL the guide's authored example (`object-extensions.mdx`, "Relabelling a vendor field") parses whole; and an agreement test that `fieldPatches` refuses at the key exactly the keys `ObjectSchema.fields` refuses, over an 11-key sample that holds keys on both sides (guarded against vacuity).

## Verification

Round 2 readings on head `fb1c5bc9` (objectstack-ai/objectstack): `origin/main` merged with `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (merge base `399df5bb`), `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` regenerated from the merged tree; the branch's delta against main is still the six files listed above. The ablation below ran in round 1 on `6a70094d`; the tested lines did not change since.

<details><summary>Ablation: the new tests can fail</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `z.record(FieldNameKeySchema, FieldDisplayPatchSchema, {` with `z.record(z.string(), FieldDisplayPatchSchema, {` in `object.zod.ts` (anchor 1 → 0, blob f24cd618 → c7a8c925), ran `src/data/field-customization.test.ts`: 5 failed | 88 passed (93), the four refusal cases and the agreement test red, every control green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The spec suite imports `./object.zod` from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
</details>

<details><summary>Consumer packages (downstream of the contract)</summary>

- `@objectstack/spec` test: 792/792 files, 23529 passed | 1 todo. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/metadata-core` (the target judge): 23/23 files, 904 tests.
- `@objectstack/objectql` (the fold that applies `fieldPatches`): 535/535 files, 10396 tests.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (the `object_extension` save door): 307 passed | 4 skipped (311), 22229 passed | 26 skipped.
- `@objectstack/cli` field-patch files (`src/utils/field-patch-targets.test.ts`, `test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`, `test/validate-field-patch-targets.test.ts`): 3/3, 41 tests.
- `@objectstack/cloud-connection` `marketplace-install-local-field-patch-targets.test.ts`: 1/1, 8 tests.
- `@objectstack/rest` `meta-object-extension-property-classes.test.ts`: 1/1, 19 tests.
- `ui` app-shell `DataPillar.baseObjectExtension-28575.test.tsx` + `StudioCustomizeControls.objectExtension-28575.test.ts`: 2/2, 19 tests.
- Every file in the repo that names `fieldPatches` in a test outside `packages/spec` is in this list; the full suites ran for the three packages the delta names.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `fb1c5bc9`: 105 commands, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:type-check-debt` first returned exit 3 (its closure build queued behind the dogfood run on the verify lock, `queue-timeout`), and was re-run once the lock was free: exit 0. `check:generated`, `check:api-surface` (no export change), `check-adr-0087-registration` (registered, new here) and `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood (narrowing arm, final head)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock on `fb1c5bc9`: 397 passed | 3 skipped (400) files; 3277 passed | 28 skipped (3305) tests; VERDICT command-exit 0. (Round 1 on `6a70094d` showed 4 reds in `flow-runas` and `declarative-endpoint-anonymous-guest` that also failed with the merge-base spec; main fixed them before this merge.)
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Not fixed here, same family: `ObjectExtensionSchema.fields` is still keyed by a bare `z.string()`. Measured at the schema: `{ extend: 'crm_account', fields: { 'Region Code': { type: 'text', label: 'Region' } } }` PARSES, so an extension can add a field whose name the target's own `fields` would refuse. Reported to the seat for a card.
- Not fixed here: `ObjectSchema.fields` refuses `constructor` / `prototype` by record refines, which are not part of the key schema; `fieldPatches: { constructor: … }` still parses at the schema (it is a valid snake_case word) and is refused by the target judge at install / `os validate` like any unknown field. Noted, not filed.
- Not fixed here, found in round 2: no ADR-0087 conversion that walks `objectExtensions[]` replays over a stored `object_extension` row either, for the same reason (no stack collection for the type). Reported to the seat.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
